# Naail Food & Beverages

> Pakistan-based manufacturer of juices, carbonated drinks, bottled water and packaged foods, based in Sheikhupura, Punjab.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "WE ARE NAAIL FOOD & BEVERAGES. BOTTLING PUNJAB'S HARVEST SINCE 2011."
url: https://naailbeverages.github.io/about/index.md
description: A Pakistan-based food and beverage manufacturer in Sheikhupura, Punjab, producing juices, carbonated drinks, drinking water and packaged snacks for distributors across all four provinces.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The company began in 2011 as a single-line juice filling unit on Lahore Road, Sheikhupura,
set up to process the mango surplus that growers in Multan and Rahim Yar Khan struggled to
move during peak season. The first product was a 250 ml mango nectar in a returnable glass
bottle, sold to roughly forty retailers in Sheikhupura district.

Demand from Lahore's wholesale market pushed us to a PET line in 2014. Carbonated soft
drinks followed in 2016, drinking water in 2017, and our snack division — namkeen mixtures
and roasted chana — opened in 2018 in a separate hall on the same site.

Today the plant runs three shifts across 4.2 acres, employs 340 people, and ships to more
than 120 distributors in Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

## How we source

We buy fruit pulp under seasonal contracts rather than on the spot market, which keeps
prices predictable for growers and keeps our flavour profile consistent batch to batch.
Mango pulp comes from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan, citrus concentrate from Sargodha and
Bhalwal, and apple concentrate from Swat and Quetta.

## Quality and certification

Every batch is tested in our on-site laboratory before it leaves the plant, and every bottle
carries a laser code identifying its production date, line, shift and blending tank. The
plant holds PSQCA, HACCP, ISO 22000:2018, ISO 9001:2015 and Halal certification.

Water for every line passes reverse osmosis, UV treatment and a 0.2 micron final filter.
Retention samples from each batch are held for twelve months at controlled temperature.

## Leadership

**Hasnain Naail** — Chief Executive. Founded the company in 2011 after a decade in fruit
pulp trading.

**Ayesha Tariq** — Director, Operations. Oversees the Sheikhupura plant and the 2023
water-line expansion.

**Bilal Ahmed Khan** — Head of Quality Assurance. Runs the in-house laboratory and the
HACCP programme.

**Farhan Siddiqui** — National Sales Manager. Manages the distributor network across all
four provinces.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "Third water line commissioned at Sheikhupura"
url: https://naailbeverages.github.io/blog/new-water-line-commissioned/index.md
date: "2026-07-14"
description: A third bottling line lifts drinking-water capacity to 60,000 bottles a day ahead of the summer peak.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We have commissioned a third drinking-water bottling line at the Sheikhupura plant, taking
water capacity from 38,000 to 60,000 bottles a day.

The line handles 500 ml and 1.5 L PET and runs off the same reverse-osmosis and UV train as
the existing two, with an added 0.2 micron final filter stage. Commissioning took eleven
weeks, and the line entered commercial production on 1 July.

## Why now

The expansion was driven by demand from Lahore and Gujranwala, where summer orders had been
running roughly 30% ahead of what the previous two lines could fill. Through May and June we
were allocating rather than filling orders, which is not a position we want to be in during
the months that matter most.

## What changes for distributors

- 500 ml case availability improves immediately in Punjab (North)
- 19 L returnable delivery in Sheikhupura and Lahore moves from thrice- to four-times
  weekly from August
- No change to trade prices this quarter

Distributors with questions about revised allocations should contact their regional manager.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "Mango intake for 2026 closes 12% above last season"
url: https://naailbeverages.github.io/blog/mango-season-2026/index.md
date: "2026-06-02"
description: Contracted pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan comes in ahead of plan despite a late start.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This year's mango pulp intake closed at 12% above the 2025 season, despite a start delayed
by roughly two weeks in the Rahim Yar Khan belt.

We contract pulp ahead of the season rather than buying spot, and this year's contracts
covered 68 growers across Multan and Rahim Yar Khan districts — nine more than last year.

## Why it matters for the product

Pulp bought on contract comes from the same orchards year after year, which is what keeps
the flavour of Naail Mango Nectar consistent from batch to batch. Spot-market pulp varies
far more in Brix and colour, and the difference is noticeable in the glass.

> Contracting early costs us flexibility on price. What it buys is a product that tastes the
> same in March as it did in July.

## Production plan

Peak nectar production runs June through September. We expect to hold 40% pulp content
across the full season with no reformulation, and to carry sufficient aseptic pulp stock
into the first quarter of 2027.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "ISO 22000 recertified through 2028"
url: https://naailbeverages.github.io/blog/iso-22000-recertification/index.md
date: "2026-04-21"
description: The Sheikhupura plant clears its three-year food safety recertification audit with no major findings.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Sheikhupura plant has been recertified to ISO 22000:2018 following a three-day audit in
April, with the certificate now valid through August 2028.

The audit covered all six production lines, the in-house laboratory, incoming material
control and the snack hall. It closed with no major non-conformities and two minor
observations, both relating to documentation rather than process.

## Observations and response

1. **Retention sample log format** — the log did not consistently record the storage
   temperature at the point of filing. We have moved the log to a fixed template with
   temperature as a required field.
2. **Supplier re-approval intervals** — two concentrate suppliers were past their scheduled
   re-approval date. Both have since been re-approved and the review calendar is now on a
   quarterly reminder.

Both were closed out within thirty days of the audit.

## Current certification status

| Certification | Valid through |
| --- | --- |
| ISO 22000:2018 | Aug 2028 |
| ISO 9001:2015 | Aug 2028 |
| HACCP | Mar 2027 |
| PSQCA licence | Dec 2027 |
| Halal certification | Jun 2027 |

title: "NAAIL MANGO NECTAR"
url: https://naailbeverages.github.io/products/naail-mango-nectar/index.md
date: "2026-03-10"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The drink the company was built on. Forty percent mango pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan,
with no artificial colour and no added preservative.

## Specification

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Fruit content** | 40% mango pulp |
| **Pack sizes** | 200 ml TBA, 250 ml PET, 1 L TBA |
| **Case configuration** | 24 × 200 ml, 24 × 250 ml, 12 × 1 L |
| **Shelf life** | 9 months ambient |
| **Storage** | Cool, dry, away from direct sunlight |

## Ingredients

Water, mango pulp (40%), sugar, citric acid, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), natural mango
flavour.

## Nutrition per 100 ml

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Energy | 54 kcal |
| Carbohydrate | 13.2 g |
| of which sugars | 12.8 g |
| Protein | 0.2 g |
| Fat | 0 g |
| Sodium | 6 mg |
| Vitamin C | 12 mg |

## Availability

Year-round. Peak production runs June through September, aligned with the mango harvest.

description: How Naail Food & Beverages handles information submitted through this website.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*This is a demonstration website. The policy below is placeholder text and has not been
reviewed by a lawyer. Replace it before the site goes live.*

## What we collect

If you submit the enquiry form on this website, we receive the name, email address, company
name and message you provide. We do not collect payment information through this site.

## How we use it

Enquiry details are used only to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to assess a
distributor application. We do not sell contact details to third parties.

## Retention

Enquiry records are retained for twenty-four months, after which they are deleted unless a
commercial relationship has been established.

## Cookies

This site does not set advertising or tracking cookies. Any analytics, if enabled, are
configured to record aggregate page views only.

## Your rights

To request a copy of the information we hold about you, or to ask for it to be deleted,
write to **hello@naailbeverages.example**.

## Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always the one published
on this page.
